text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 680 College Street, Beatrice Street flankage
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item TE3.19 indefinitely.
